title: ATS Jobs Scraper output
description: One dataset item per job, plus a SUMMARY record with per-company counts.

results.title: Jobs
results.description: One row per job: company, title, links, locations, remote flag, employment type, department, posted date, salary range and description. Inputs or boards that could not be read appear with ok=false and a reason, and are not charged.

summary.title: Per-company summary
summary.description: For each board: how it was found, jobs on the board, jobs that passed the filters and jobs written.
